thread: design-validation: how close is the designed organism (winged zebrafish) to the real flying fish
rules: cite only what was fetched in this thread or read locally
no personal identifiers in any request
no bird data: class Aves is the project's frozen holdout

calls.why: Daane et al. 2021 Data S1 (publisher supplement, Elsevier CDN mmc2.xlsx) for doi 10.1016/j.cub.2021.08.054, PMID 34534441. Sheets G, I, J, K, M read for Part 2; all 14 sheets searched for the design's genes.
the DESIGN specification: panel B is the winged zebrafish (lat4a nr21/+ x kcnh2a lof/+). Also the source of the authors' quotes used in Part 4.
flying-fish pectoral/SL: median 0.687, range 0.406-0.823, n = 49 museum specimens.
Davenport 1992 exponents: mass vs SL 2.981, lateral fin area vs SL 1.834, wing loading vs SL 1.236 (abstracts, one species, no CI).
Park and Choi 2010 Table 1 model L3 and Table 2 (the REAL fish arm of the gate); field glide summaries.
FishBase length-weight list; the 6 fitted flying-fish studies with locality and n give the measured b range 2.208-3.011.
zebrafish baseline morphometrics: max body depth / SL 0.2865 (jiang2026); pectoral fin rays 10 (corcoran2026).
zebrafish baseline: adult at 365 d SL 0.04426 m, mass 0.001058 kg; length-weight b 3.22 (Beaudouin 2015); and finLength_SL returns null, which is the pre-registered gap on axis 1.
the constraint checker; check() run on the real fish, on the design and on the matched control.
read to learn the required call shape before running the gate.
the existing audit of 111 theorems against the real flying fish: 22 hold, 11 violated, 78 cannot-evaluate. Pre-registered as the reason to run the gate on the real animal too.
the form this run log follows.
this thread's own pre-registration, hashed before the first number.
verify the flying-fish gene-set numbers used as denominator CONTEXT in Part 2 rather than citing them from the thread brief

what_was_verified.verbatim: We predicted 23,611 protein-coding genes in the mirrorwing flyingfish genome, with an average gene length of 14.35 kb.
what_was_verified.figshare: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.14600634.v1 (listed under online repositories; the page does not state it holds the annotation specifically)
what_was_verified.citation: Xu P, Zhao C, You X, Yang F, Chen J, Ruan Z, Gu R, Xu J, Bian C, Shi Q. Draft Genome of the Mirrorwing Flyingfish (Hirundichthys speculiger). Front Genet. 2021 Jul 7;12:695700. doi 10.3389/fgene.2021.695700

calls.note: the page is 132,989 characters and only the first 100,000 were read; the gene count, BioProject, figshare DOI and citation were all inside that span

calls.what: no other network call was made
calls.detail: Parts 1, 2 and 3 are computed entirely from files already in the repository. The flying-fish gene set itself (23,611 genes) was NOT downloaded: it is used only as a denominator-scale reference, and nothing in (a), (b), (c) or (d) depends on it.
calls.holdout: no bird (Aves) data was requested, fetched, or used anywhere; none was needed
